description: This file defines the ServicePeriod class within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends FilterField to provide functionality for adding where clauses to a database query related to employee service periods based on their join dates. It utilizes traits and external query builder classes to construct the query logic, including support for operators like LESS_THAN, GREATER_THAN, and BETWEEN.

classes.name: ServicePeriod
classes.description: A class extending FilterField to manage filtering employee service periods based on their joining date, supporting operators like less than, greater than, and between.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds conditional expressions to a query builder to filter employees based on their service period, comparing the difference between the current date and employee's join date using specified operators.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in the query, in this case, 'employee'.
